product.title: Jeep 4 X 4 Yosemite Park Tour with Hotel Pickup

description.text: If you just have one day to experience all the wonders of Yosemite, make the most of it with a full-day private Jeep tour that showcases the park’s supersized attractions and amazing ecosystems. Vehicle passes and parking can be tough to come by, so let a guide handle all the driving and logistics while you enjoy the rugged ride—top down optional.

highlights: Sturdy Jeep 4x4 can tackle all park roads and conditions
Avoid ticket sell outs, traffic jams, and long waits for parking
All-inclusive package includes hotel pickup and a picnic lunch
Private tour can be totally customized around your interests

start.description: Hotel pickup from select Oakhurst, Fish Camp, Bass Lake, and Mariposa-area hotels. Meet your guide at the agreed pickup point between 7:00 AM and 7:30 AM.

end.description: Return to your hotel or original pickup location after the full-day private Jeep loop through Yosemite Valley and Glacier Point.

product.itinerarySummary: If you just have one day to experience all the wonders of Yosemite, make the most of it with a full-day private Jeep tour that showcases the park’s supersized attractions and amazing ecosystems.

itineraryItems.title: Tunnel View
itineraryItems.description: Stop at the classic overlook for panoramic views of El Capitan, Half Dome, and Bridalveil Fall.

itineraryItems.title: Bridalveil Fall
itineraryItems.description: Walk to the base of Bridalveil Fall for misty views of the cascade.

itineraryItems.title: Sentinel Bridge
itineraryItems.description: Photo stop on Sentinel Bridge with views of Yosemite Falls and Half Dome.

itineraryItems.title: Yosemite Falls
itineraryItems.description: Stop near Lower Yosemite Fall for a short walk and waterfall views.

itineraryItems.title: El Capitan Meadow
itineraryItems.description: Photo stop beneath the granite walls of El Capitan.

itineraryItems.title: Glacier Point
itineraryItems.description: Rim overlook with sweeping views of Yosemite Valley and Half Dome.

itineraryItems.title: Sentinel Dome
itineraryItems.description: Pass Sentinel Dome on the route when seasonal access permits.

itineraryItems.title: Washburn Point
itineraryItems.description: Short stop at Washburn Point for high-country views.

itineraryItems.title: Pioneer Yosemite History Center
itineraryItems.description: Pass through the Wawona area history center when included in your route.

itineraryItems.title: The Ahwahnee
itineraryItems.description: Optional stop at The Ahwahnee historic building in Yosemite Valley.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

Where does the tour depart from in Yosemite?
faqs.answer: Hotel pickup from select Oakhurst, Fish Camp, Bass Lake, and Mariposa-area hotels. Meet your guide at the agreed pickup point between 7:00 AM and 7:30 AM.
